summary: Phase F.1 (Structural Multi-page Templates) — BACKEND 14/14 NEW + 19/19 F.0 regression = 33/33 PASS. FRONTEND verified live: TemplatePicker loads 13 cards; structural templates show '8 pagine' and '6 pagine' badges via data-testid='template-page-count-{slug}' with Layers icon; Luxury card renders multi-layered stack (4 SVGs) while Material Board renders single SVG (correct per spec); IT i18n strings present (AVVIO RAPIDO, Tela vuota, Apri, pagine, Derivato da un altro template, Sostituisci con immagine, Aggiungi pagina); apply flow E2E → 8 pages cloned with localized page-type labels (Copertina / Citazione / Mood / Palette / ...), placeholder ★ HERO COVE... rendered with required marker, page tiles visible in PagesNavigator; '+' add-page-btn header button and inline dashed 'Aggiungi pagina' tile present on fixture moodboard. NO bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: templates._attach_preview correctly emits pages_preview carousel only when len(pages) > 1; single-page templates get page_count=1 without carousel. Verified: Luxury 8/8 SVGs, Hospitality 6/6 SVGs, Material Board no carousel.

apply_template clones template_pages → moodboard_pages, builds page_id_map, then attaches each template_block to the corresponding new page_id. landing_page_id is the first cloned page (sort_order ASC). Placeholder metadata correctly propagated via metadata_json.placeholder = {label,type,required}. Verified by test_apply_luxury_creates_8_pages_with_placeholders.

save_as_template snapshots multi-page round-trip: source 6-page moodboard → template with 6 template_pages + 6 pages_preview → re-apply produces 6 cloned pages with elements properly scoped. Round-trip verified.

Cross-tenant: studio2 CAN read platform structural templates (RBAC by ownership: archived_at is null + tenant_id IS NULL — platform-visible) and CAN apply to their own tenant, but the resulting moodboard lives in studio2 tenant; designer GET on it returns 404. No leak. Verified.
RBAC client → 403 on POST apply + POST from-moodboard fires BEFORE resource lookup (decorator-level). Verified.

TemplatePicker UI: page-count badge uses data-testid='template-page-count-structural-luxury-residential' = '8 pagine' (and 6 pagine for hospitality). Material Board (single page) intentionally does NOT show a page-count badge — matches spec ('badge for multi-page templates').

Note (minor): page tiles in PagesNavigator do NOT match data-testid='page-tile-{id}' selector — agent context referenced this pattern but rendered DOM uses a different attribute; visual proof of 8 tiles confirms the UI behavior is correct. Main agent may want to standardize data-testid on the page tile element for next-iteration test automation.

context_for_next_testing_agent: F.1 GREEN. SaveAsTemplate Pydantic model requires `slug` (3-64 chars) in addition to `name` — easy to miss in payload. Blueprint i18n endpoint is /api/blueprint/i18n/{locale} (path segment), NOT ?locale=it (query). 'AVVIO RAPIDO' / 'PAGINE' eyebrows in the UI are rendered uppercase via CSS text-transform but source IT strings are 'Avvio rapido' / 'Pagine' — match the source form when grepping i18n response, and the rendered form when grepping page.innerText in Chromium. TemplatePicker spinner takes 8-12s on first paint due to 13 templates × N pages × preview SVG fetches; use page.wait_for_timeout(12000) before asserting cards. Material Board structural template intentionally has NO page-count badge (single page). The 4-svg count on Luxury card includes 3 stacked mini-previews + 1 palette swatch container — proves layered design.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in F.1 implementation. Backend, integrations, RBAC, cross-tenant isolation, i18n IT — all GREEN.
